general_information.Description: - This course satisfies the Graphic Design Faculty component of FPT University. Students will engage with technical, practical, and concept based problems involved with the practice of watercolor painting. Color theory, techniques, materials, and application will be explored throughout the term. Projects will include painting from the still life, model, landscape and images. - This course presents students with the basic techniques and concepts that are common to various painting media, with the emphasis placed on the watercolor medium. students in watercolor course will be exposed to both subjectively and technically. This course will also examine the interdependence of medium and image. Further more the course will provide basic knowledge of color application in visual design. - This course will be organized in a studio. During class time, practice exercises will come right after each of theories. Students create art works after lectures and tutorials. These art works will be analyzed and evaluated by students under the control of lecturer. Finally, they will be graded by the lecturer. - Students collect all of their art works to make the portfolios.
general_information.StudentTasks: '- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance
general_information.Tools: MATERIALS TO CLASS Paper: - 2 pads of Newsprint 1 pad of multi use drawing paper, watercolor paper! A few sheets of high quality paper for some projects, Sketch book - To start: 5 sheets of Arches 140 lb. (or 300lb) Cold pressed Watercolor paper (22x30 inches) - Note that you will need to get additional paper as the term progresses. Additional Supplies: - Erasers. Both Plastic and Kneaded - Palette: Something with a white base is best and with space for colors and adequate mixing area - Water container - Sponge - Towel - Drawing Board: Something big enough for A3 paper - Roll of masking tape. - Graphite pencils, 3B, 4B, 6B - Two jars for water storage - One watercolor palette - Watercolor sticks - Tool chest for carrying materials - Portfolio (paper is fine. It is fine if you want to make one out of cardboard or other stiff material.) Minimum 26 x 34 inches Brushes: - #6, #12 Round (Sable) - 1” or larger flat brush - Inexpensive round brush that can be used for masking fluid (be sure that it comes to a tip for detailing) - Brushe Fibers: Sable, Squrrel, Ox, Goat, Sabeline, Synthetics,Blends Brushe Styles: Rounds, Flats, Brichts, Filbets, Oval Mops, Scripts and Riccers, Bamboo, Hake, Large Wash Brushs, Retractable Brushes
